name: Chloe Bannister
summary: Primary school teacher with three years of classroom experience across Foundation to Year 3 in Victorian Catholic and government schools. Strong focus on early literacy: explicit, systematic synthetic phonics, decodable texts, small-group reading intervention and data-informed planning. Fully registered with the Victorian Institute of Teaching (Proficient Teacher), holds a Working with Children Check, Australian citizen, looking for an ongoing primary classroom role in Melbourne.
skills: Level 2 First Aid and anaphylaxis management

experience.description: Teaches a Year 3 class of 24 across the Victorian Curriculum 2.0. Runs a small-group phonics and fluency intervention for Year 3/4 students below benchmark (14 of 18 reached the expected level). Moved the Year 3 team to decodable texts and a shared phonics scope and sequence; leads literacy moderation. Uses PAT Reading, phonics checks and running records to plan differentiation and IEPs. Mentors pre-service teachers.

Taught Foundation and Year 1 classes. Delivered daily explicit phonemic awareness and phonics lessons, introduced a whole-class handwriting routine, completed VIT provisional-to-full registration with a mentor, ran parent information sessions on home reading. Gained Accreditation to Teach in a Catholic School.

experience.company: Government and independent primary schools, Melbourne
experience.description: Four placements in Years F-6, including an 80-day final placement in Year 2.

education.degree: Bachelor of Education (Primary), specialisation in English and literacy education
